snippet.title: Parting Shadows — Official Trailer | Narrative RPG April 2026
snippet.description:
Three stories. 6 classes. Every choice changes what you fight, who you lose, and how it ends.

Parting Shadows launches on Steam in April 2026.

Every choice splits the story into genuinely different routes — different battles,
enemies, and endings. One playthrough only covers roughly half the content.

Three self-contained stories. 6 Classes. 34 Specializations across 3 upgrade tiers. ATB combat with
turn order prediction, crits, dodges, and status effects. 140+ abilities. Co-op
for 2-3 players locally or online — when the story branches, the group votes.
